policy: One active task plus immutable pending record. Source completion and digital tail-empty are both required. Optional bound sink fence/ack with exact token is required only when requested at start; absent binding never sets sink_confirmed. First nonzero cancellation reason is retained; invalid time clears all timestamps. Hard reset discards state; no soft reset input. No RF output completion claim. REPLAY_ABORT=4 is valid only for source REPLAY and indicates a reader or DSP cancellation; it is not RF consumption evidence.
